script.title: REPORTING ANTS IN THE KITCHEN
script.story_hook: Reporting ants in the kitchen to my landlord on Monday.
script.intro_zh: 星期一向房東回報廚房裡的螞蟻。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, everyone! Today: ants, ants, and more ants.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，各位！今天的主題：螞蟻，到處都是螞蟻。
script.outro: That's our episode for today. Keep listening, and see you soon!
script.outro_zh: 今天的節目就到這裡。持續練習聽力，我們很快再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's your turn: read each line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你跟著我，一句一句朗讀。

script.char_b_description: a plump Japanese woman in her late fifties with shoulder-length silver hair in soft curls, wearing a burgundy knit cardigan and a pearl necklace, waving her hand kindly
script.youtube_title: 【🐜🍳廚房除蟲英文】「請派人來處理」怎麼說？18句蟲害報修對話，房東立刻行動🏠｜Kitchen Ants English
script.youtube_title_en: “We Need Real Pest Control” — Reporting Ants in the Kitchen
script.youtube_description:
廚房驚見一長列黑螞蟻，該怎麼用英文請房東處理？這段18句的蟲害報修對話，教你描述蟲害狀況、分清楚租約裡的責任歸屬、配合除蟲前的準備，約好到場時間。整段自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就會開口報修。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
A line of black ants marching across your kitchen? Learn how to tell your landlord in English! This 18-line pest-control call covers describing the problem, clarifying who pays under the lease, prepping the cabinets, and booking a visit. Natural American English with IPA and translation, then repeat every line out loud in the second half.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏠廚房除蟲英文｜描述蟲害・責任歸屬・預約到場｜聽完就會報修｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
廚房出現一長串螞蟻，該自己處理還是找房東？
除蟲的錢到底算誰的？英文怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進一間讓螞蟻光顧的出租廚房，跟著房客從回報蟲害狀況、確認租約裡的責任歸屬，到清空櫥櫃、相約除蟲公司到場的時間，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🐜 描述蟲害：例如「tiny black ones, everywhere in my kitchen」、「they come back the very next day」。
📄 確認責任：例如「is that covered by my lease?」、「that's our responsibility」。
🧽 約時間與準備：例如「empty the cabinets and wipe the counters」、「Thursday morning works for them」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次小蟲再光顧，你也知道怎麼用英文請人來趕走牠！
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a line of ants on the counter

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi Mrs. Chen, do you have a minute? Small problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈmɪsəz tʃɛn du ju hæv ə ˈmɪnɪt smɔl ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 陳太太，方便借用一下時間嗎？有點小狀況。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh dear, what happened this time?
dialogue.zh: 噢，天哪，這次又發生什麼事了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ants! Tiny black ones, everywhere in my kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænts ˈtaɪni blæk wʌnz ˈɛwəˌrɛr ɪn maɪ ˈkɪtʃən/
dialogue.zh: 螞蟻！很小的黑螞蟻，我廚房裡到處都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ugh, that's awful. How long have you seen them?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ ðæts ˈɔfəl haʊ lɔŋ hæv ju sin ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 噁，那真糟糕。你看到牠們多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About a week, mostly near the sink and crumbs.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ə wik ˈmoʊstli nɪr ðə sɪŋk ænd krʌmz/
dialogue.zh: 大約一週了，主要在水槽跟食物碎屑旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay. Have you tried the store spray already?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ hæv ju traɪd ðə stɔr spreɪ ɔlˈrɛdi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did, but they come back the very next day.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd bət ðeɪ kʌm bæk ðə ˈvɛri nɛkst deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 有啊，但牠們隔天又全來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, then we need real pest control.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðɛn wi nid rɪl pɛst kənˈtroʊl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那就得請真正的除蟲公司處理了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that covered by my lease, or on me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈkʌvərd baɪ maɪ lis ɔr ɑn mi/
dialogue.zh: 這在租約上是誰負責？還是我得出錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For bugs inside the unit, that's our responsibility.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr bʌɡz ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈjunɪt ðæts ˈaʊər rɪˌspɑnsəˈbɪləti/
dialogue.zh: 室內蟲害通常是由房東這邊負責。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, great news. I already checked behind the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡreɪt nuz aɪ ˈɔlˌrɛdi tʃɛkt bɪˈhɑɪnd ðə frɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 哦，太好了。我已經檢查過冰箱後面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please empty the cabinets and wipe the counters down.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz ˈɛmti ðə ˈkæbənəts ænd waɪp ðə ˈkaʊntərz daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩先把櫃子清空，再把流理台擦一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure thing. When could the company come by?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊr θɪŋ wɛn kʊd ðə ˈkʌmpəni kʌm baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。他們什麼時候可以到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday morning works for them, is that fine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrzdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ wɜrks fɔr ðɛm ɪz ðæt faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 星期四早上他們有空，那個時間可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday's perfect. I'll be home, or leave a key.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrzdeɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪl bi hoʊm ɔr liv ə ki/
dialogue.zh: 週四很棒。我可以在家等，或是留一把鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, I'll text you the confirmation today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt aɪl tɛkst ju ðə ˌkɑnfərˈmeɪʃən təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我今天會傳訊息跟你確認。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks a lot! I really hate those tiny guests.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ə lɑt aɪ ˈrɪli heɪt ðoʊz ˈtaɪni ɡɛsts/
dialogue.zh: 太感謝了！我真的很討厭這些小房客。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me about it. Thursday, then. Take care!
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ɪt ˈθɜrzdeɪ ðɛn teɪ kɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我懂你的感受。那就週四見，照顧好自己！
